source: 588 Degree of Madness
target: 588 Gradus Insaniae

source: 588 Degree of Madness
target: 588 Gradus Insaniae

source: Mr. K shifted instantaneously, tapping into the Grazed Traveler’s soul.
target: Mr. K statim se mutavit, animam Viatoris Pasciti attigens.

source: His eyes took on an otherworldly glow, as if concealing doors to different realms.
target: Oculi eius luce aliena micaverunt, quasi ostia ad alia regna celarent.

source: His form faded, and in an instant, a luminous white column surrounded by flames emerged, shrouding him within its fiery embrace.
target: Forma eius evanuit, et in uno momento, columna alba fulgente, flammas circumdata, apparuit, eum in igneo amplexu tegens.

source: In the ensuing moment, Mr. K, stripped of his Devil guise, materialized in a corner of the metallic beehive.
target: In momento sequente, Mr. K, veste Diaboli depulsa, in angulo alvearii metallici apparuit.

source: His form liquefied, his flesh resembling dripping candle wax.
target: Forma eius liquefacta est, et caro eius quasi cera candelae stillans videbatur.

source: The Secrets Suppliant pathway symbolized corruption, its influence curtailed by the Sun pathway’s capabilities.
target: Iter Secretorum Supplicantis corruptionem significabat, cuius potentia a facultatibus itineris Solis coartata erat.

source: Half-melted flesh and blood cascaded onto the metal floor, seeping into it in a bizarre manner.
target: Caro semi-liquefacta et sanguis in pavimentum metallicum ceciderunt, modo insolito in eum infiltrantes.

source: Soon, it was absorbed by the spaceship Mad Lady had earlier detailed.
target: Mox id ab nave siderali, quam Mad Lady antea descripserat, absorptum est.

source: Even Mr. K felt the weight of an unseen force, as if an invisible hand pressed him down.
target: Etiam Mr. K pondus vis invisibilis sensit, quasi manus invisibilis eum premeret.

source: His attempts to extricate himself from the metallic floor proved futile, and he continued sinking gradually.
target: Conatus eius ex pavimento metallico se liberandi frustra erant, atque paulatim demergi continuavit.

source: Mad Lady, with grayish-green eyes gleaming, teleported near Mr. K.
target: Mad Lady, oculis cinereo-viridibus fulgentibus, se prope Mr. K translocavit.

source: Despite his blood-colored wax-drenched visage, Mr. K faced Mad Lady without a trace of fear.
target: Non obstante vultu eius, qui cera sanguine tinctus apparuerat, Mr. K Mad Lady sine ullo timore opposuit.

source: His focus remained fixed on the evil god’s aura emanating from the metal hive—his ultimate target.
target: Attentio eius manebat ad aurem dei maligni, quae ex alveo metallico efferebatur—quod propositum ultimum eius erat.

source: He switched the Grazed soul to an Arbiter pathway Beyonder, with two bolts of lightning gathering in the depths of his darkened eyes.
target: Animam “Grazed” ad iter Arbiter Beyonder convertit, cum duo fulmina in profundo oculorum eius obscurorum congregata essent.

source: Psychic Piercing!
target: Perforatio Mentis!

source: Mad Lady refrained from teleporting.
target: Mad Lady se non translocavit.

source: The illusory book within her eyes flipped open, revealing the kaleidoscope of colors on Mr. K’s body and the shifting hues of light during his Grazed soul transitions.
target: Liber illusorius in oculis eius aperuit, revelans kaleidoscopium colorum in corpore Mr. K et mutabiles lucis tintae in transmutationibus animae “Grazed.”

source: Excitement illuminated Mad Lady’s face.
target: Excitatio faciem Mad Lady illustravit.

source: Raising her right hand, she prepared to delicately twist it clockwise.
target: Manu dextra elevata, parata est eam leniter in gyrum dextrum torquere.

source: Steal!
target: Furare!

source: This was an ability she had Recorded from Bard.
target: Haec erat facultas, quam ex Bard didicerat.

source: A sudden, intriguing notion captivated Mad Lady’s thoughts—she yearned to witness the aftermath of stealing the Grazing ability from a Shepherd.
target: Subito, notio intrigans cogitationes Mad Lady ceperat—desiderabat videre consequentias furtum facultatis “Grazing” a Pastore.

source: It was crucial to understand that her Steal ability was limited to just one from a target, devoid of any connections to the abilities that came with it.
target: Maxime oportet intellegere facultatem eius furtandi ad unam tantum rem pertinere, sine ullis nexus ad facultates quae cum ea veniebant.

source: In essence, after snatching the Grazing ability, the soul, characteristics, and powers under Grazing’s influence would persist within Mr. K’s body.
target: Essentialiter, post facultatem “Grazing” rapuendam, anima, virtutes et proprietates eius in corpore Mr. K permanere debebant.

source: In this state, Mad Lady pondered whether Shepherds would grapple with internal conflicts, the fusion of characteristics, or a loss of control akin to the switching between non‐adjacent pathways.
target: In hoc statu, Mad Lady quaerebat num Pastores internis contentionibus, mixtione proprietatum, aut detrimento imperii, similis commutationi inter vias non contiguas laborarent.

source: Excitement bubbled within Mad Lady as she deliberately Blinked near Mr. K, compelling him to switch Grazed souls.
target: Excitatio intra Mad Lady efferebatur, dum illa deliberato ictu “blink” se prope Mr. K transposuit, eum compellens ut animas “Grazed” commutaret.

source: She observed keenly, eager to discern which light aligned with Grazing.
target: Ipsa diligenter contemplavit, desiderans discernere quam lucem cum “Grazing” congrueret.

source: As for Mr. K’s reaction, she cared little.
target: Quantum ad reactionem Mr. K, illa parum curabat.

source: "You continue your fight; I continue my steal. Whoever dies first loses!"
target: "Tu pugnam tuam pergas; ego furtum meum pergo. Qui primum moriatur, perit!"

source: Simultaneously, the metal floor, saturated with Mr. K’s flesh, quivered unexpectedly.
target: Simul, planum metallicum, Mr. K carne impregnatum, inopinato tremuit.

source: A previously concealed door within the metal hive withdrew, unveiling a passageway that hinted at a silver metallic hall beyond.
target: Porta, antea in alveo metallico abscondita, se recepit, detegens iter quod ad aulam metallicam argenteam ultra spectabat.

source: A formidable suction force emanated from that direction.
target: Vis fortis attractionis ex illa regione emansit.

source: While her attempt to steal Mr. K’s Grazing ability was underway, Mad Lady—lacking the strength—was propelled into the air.
target: Dum eius conatus ad furtum facultatis “Grazing” Mr. K procedebat, Mad Lady—vi carens—in caelum impellita est.

source: Dark-blond hair whipped around wildly as she soared toward the origin of the anomaly.
target: Capilli obscuro-flavi, furibunde circumvolitantes, dum illa ad originem anomaliae volitabat.

source: Meanwhile, Mr. K remained “locked” to the metal floor.
target: Interim, Mr. K in pavimento metallico “clausus” mansit.

source: Though his body swayed precariously, on the verge of being pulled away, he held his ground, unsteady yet resilient.
target: Quamquam corpus eius periculum circumtrebat, prope eripiendum, sed in loco suo manebat, vacillans sed constans.

source: The face of the blood-colored wax-streaked Aurora Order Oracle betrayed an anxious expression.
target: Vultus oraculi Ordinationis Aurorae, cera sanguine tincta, anxietatem prodidit.

source: The enemy was on the verge of escape!
target: Hostis fere effugiens erat!

source: The source of the evil god corruption had revealed itself!
target: Fons corruptionis dei mali se manifesta erat!

source: Mr. K swiftly switched back to the corresponding Devil spirit, summoning a broadsword forged from crimson lava and pale-blue flames.
target: Mr. K celeriter ad spiritum Diaboli aptum rediit, invocans gladium latum ex lava rubra et flammarum caeruleis pallidis confectum.

source: Targeting his body adhered to the metal floor, he executed a slashing motion.
target: In corpore, quod ad pavimentum metallico adnexus erat, motum secandi exercuit.

source: Beneath his calf, flesh promptly separated from his main body, the incision undergoing a mesmerizing melding of half-melting and half-reforming.
target: Sub crus eius, caro celeriter a corpore principali discrepat, incisione quae mixtionem quasi mediarum liquefactionis et reformationis subibat.

source: Having relinquished a portion of his flesh, Mr. K allowed pale-white, moist, and freshly-formed limbs to squirm out from the severed stump.
target: Dimittens partem carnis suae, Mr. K permisit membris pallide albis, humidis, ac recens formatis ex ramo secato emergere.

source: Concurrently, he harnessed the formidable suction force to pursue Mad Lady and draw closer to the source of corruption.
target: Simul, vim attractionis formidabilis ad usum correxit, ut Mad Lady insecutus esset atque ad fontem corruptionis propius accederet.

source: In midair, he witnessed Lumian, disguised, clutching the door frame in a struggle against the menacing suction.
target: In medio aere, perspexit Lumianum, late indutum, qui limam ostii retinebat in certamine adversus vim attrahentem minam.

source: He observed the motionless silver‑white full‑body armor seamlessly blending with the floor.
target: Observavit loricam totam argentino-albem, immobiliter, quam pavimento leniter coniunctam esse.

source: Mad Lady surged ahead, on the verge of “flying” past Lumian.
target: Mad Lady praepropulsa est, paene volitans praeter Lumian.

source: With a wave of her right hand, she emitted a greeting‑like “hello”, her face radiating excitement and anticipation.
target: Dextra manu fluctuantem, edidit quasi salutem “salve”, faciem eius ex excitatione et expectatione fulgentem ostendens.

source: Lumian’s pupils constricted.
target: Pupillae Lumiani contractae sunt.

source: Disregarding his precarious state, he harrumphed.
target: Non curans statu incerto, fremivit.

source: Two beams of white light shot forth from his nostrils, accurately aimed at Mad Lady but influenced by the tangible and enigmatic suction force.
target: Duo radios lucis albae ex naribus eius emiserunt, rite ad Mad Lady intunti, sed vis attractionis tangibilis atque arcana eos affluente.

source: They bent and “plunged” deeper into the tunnel.
target: Ipsi flecti sunt et in tunellum profundius descendebant.

source: At that moment, Lumian’s grip on the silver metal door frame neared its breaking point, blood seeping from the strain.
target: In illo momento, tenentia Lumiani in limam ostii metallici argentei fere ad exitium accessit, et sanguis ex labore stillabat.

source: Faintly, he sensed an abundance of flesh and skin deep within the tunnel, intertwining to shape a colossal structure resembling a pear‑shaped bird’s nest.
target: Leviter sensit multitudinem carnis et cutis in profundo tunelli, quae se intertexebant ut formam ingentis structurae, quasi nidus avis pera figurae, concipi.

source: Suspended in midair, fleshy ropes, as thick as two or three adult arms and covered in a translucent membrane, extended, linking the distant wall, the ceiling above, and the metal on the ground.
target: Suspendi in medio aere, funes carnosi, tam crassi quam duo vel tres brachia adultorum, membrana translucida operti, se extendebant, parietem remotum, laquearium superiorem, et metallum in terra ligantes.

source: Within these flesh and blood tendrils, specks of starlight and a mysterious dark substance flowed into the massive pear‑shaped object.
target: In his tendrillis carnis et sanguinis, micellae lucis stellarum et substantia obscura arcana in ingens obiectum, forma pera simile, fluere coeperunt.

source: The bird’s nest‑like structure was contracting inward, its various parts deeply sunken, delineating lines that hinted at a substantial disk.
target: Structura, similis nido avium, in se compingebatur, partes variae alte deiectae, lineas formantes, quae ad discum robustum insinuabant.

source: The terrifying suction force, capable of manipulating both reality and mystery, emanated from this pear‑shaped object composed of skin, flesh, and blood.
target: Atrox vis aspirationis, quae et rem ac et arcanum regere posset, ex hoc obiecto formae pera, a cute, carne et sanguine confecto, emanasit.

source: At that moment, the outlines on the pear‑shaped object quivered, and all the indentations bulged and expanded.
target: Id momento, contorni in obiecto formae pera tremuerunt, et omnes cavitates dilatatae atque expansae sunt.

source: With this transformation, fragments of starlight spilled from the fleshy bird’s nest, rushing into every cabin within the spaceship.
target: Hoc mutatione, fragmenta lucis stellarum ex nido carnoso avium effusa sunt, ad omnes compartimenta intra navem sideralem festinanter descendentes.

source: This event resembled the prior two releases of the sea’s power, yet lacked the grandeur and vastness, lacking the potential to rend apart anyone obstructing its path.
target: Hoc eventum priorem duorum emissionum potentiae maris simile erat, sed maiestatem atque immensitatem defuit, nec habuit facultatem quemlibet iter obstare discindendi.

source: Lumian could already envision the repetitive expulsion, understanding that the silver‑gray behemoth had amassed a power capable of threatening the seal.
target: Lumian iam repetitam expulsionem praevidere poterat, intellectus quod ingens titulus argenteo-cinereus potestatem congregaverat, qua sigillum minari posset.

source: Year after year, it required the extraction of this accumulated pressure.
target: Anno post annum, haec pressio congregata extrahenda erat.

source: As the abundance of starlight scattered, the formidable suction force dissipated.
target: Sicut abundantia lucis stellarum dispersa est, vis suctionis formidabilis evanuit.

source: With two thuds, Mad Lady and Mr. K collided with the ground.
target: Duobus ictibus, Mad Lady et Mr. K cum terra colliserunt.

source: One found herself in the tunnel leading to the fleshy “bird’s nest,” while the other lay in the silver hall where Lumian and Ultraman had previously battled.
target: Una ipsa se invenit in tunello, qui ad nidum carnosi “avianum” ducebat, dum altera in aula argentea iacebat, ubi Lumian et Ultraman olim pugnaverant.

source: Lumian released his grip, landing on the ground.
target: Lumian emisit tenentiam, et in terram cecidit.

source: His gaze swiftly fixated on the April Fool’s key member, adorned with clumps of flesh and blood on her face.
target: Oculus eius celeriter surrexit ad membrum clavis Aprilis Stultorum, quod facie agglutinata carne et sanguine ornatum erat.

source: Mad Lady sprang up, exclaiming to him and Mr. K, “Did you see that? Did you see that? That’s an incubating deity. Yes, it should be a deity!”
target: Mad Lady surrexit et ad eum atque Mr. K exclamavit: “Vidistisne id? Vidistisne id? Illa deitas incipientis est. Etiam, deitas esse debet!”

source: Despite the intense fluctuations in Mad Lady’s emotions, Mr. K discerned no sincerity in her tone.
target: Non obstante affectuum fluctuationibus intensis in Mad Lady, Mr. K ullam sinceritatem in eius voce deprehendit.

source: Her mention of “deity” sounded more like “powerful and terrifying monster,” a mere description.
target: Eius meminisse de “deitate” magis audiebatur ut “monstrum potentissimum et terribile,” simpliciter descriptum.

source: In the next instant, Lumian materialized behind Mad Lady, who promptly vanished on the spot, “Blinking” closer to where the starlight had scattered.
target: In proximo momento, Lumian post Mad Lady apparuit, quae statim in loco evanuit, translata propius ad locum ubi lux stellarum dispersa erat.

source: Lumian, sensing danger instinctively, felt his heart quicken involuntarily.
target: Lumian, per instinctum periculum sentiens, cor suum involuntario celeriter pulsare sensit.

source: He hesitated to delve too deeply into the tunnel, avoiding proximity to the flesh and blood “bird’s nest” he had vaguely “seen” before.
target: Lumian dubitavit, vere appropinquare “nido” carne et sanguine constituto in profundo tunelli non volens.

source: Unimaginable horrors were certain to unfold.
target: Horrores incredibiles certissime evenire debebant.

source: However, Mad Lady sprinted in that direction.
target: At Mad Lady in illam partem citissime cucurrit.

source: Let her venture deeper and potentially meet her end?
target: Liceretne illam ulterius proficisci atque fortasse mortem pati?

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced, torn between decisions.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani festinanter vehuntur, inter decisiones divisae.

source: Another second passed, and Mr. K teleported in front of Lumian, fervently pursuing Mad Lady.
target: Altera secunda pertransiit, et Mr. K ante Lumian se teleportavit, ardenter Mad Lady insecutus.

source: In that moment, Lumian, who had often considered himself a bit eccentric, found himself yearning for a bit more normalcy from the duo ahead of him.
target: In eo momento, Lumian, qui se saepe aliquantulum eccentricum censuerat, invenerat se desiderare paulo maiorem normalitatem ab illis duobus ante se.

source: While he could comprehend Mr. K’s choices and actions—rooted in unwavering faith in God and the pursuit of divine will, coupled with a hint of extremism—Mad Lady’s conduct exceeded his expectations.
target: Dum intellectum habere poterat de electionibus et officiis Mr. K, fundatis in fide in Deum perpetua et in studio voluntatis divinae, addito aliquo signo extremismi, agendi ratio Mad Lady exspectationes eius superabat.

source: Drawing from I Know Someone’s confession and Mad Lady’s previous behavior, Lumian detected no signs of her fanatical devotion to the Celestial Worthy.
target: Ex confessione “I Know Someone” et ex praeteritis actis Mad Lady, Lumian nullos vestigia devotio fanaticam ad Celestial Worthy deprehendit.

source: Simultaneously, due to the ongoing conflict between the Celestial Worthy and Mr. Fool, she couldn’t always rely on protection.
target: Simul, ob contentiones inter Celestial Worthy et Mr. Fool, illa non semper in tutela inniti potuit.

source: This raised a question for Lumian.
target: Hoc quaestionem Lumiani excitavit.

source: If Mad Lady consistently courted danger, how had she managed to survive to this day?
target: Si Mad Lady constanter periculum coniungeret, quomodo usque ad hanc diem superfuerit?

source: April Fool’s lacked the strict hierarchy and coordination seen in the Aurora Order.
target: April Fool’s caret stricta hierarchia et coordinatione, ut in Ordine Aurorae observabatur.

source: Most of the time, members operated independently with minimal interaction.
target: Plurimis temporibus, membra independentissime agebant, minimo commercio inter se.

source: Protecting Mad Lady from the start, allowing her to grow steadily with such a mindset, seemed implausible.
target: A principio Mad Lady protegi, ut cum tali animo constanter cresceret, videbatur inverisimile.

source: Could it be that I Know Someone had once overseen the treatment of Mad Lady’s mental and psychological issues?
target: Numquid fieri potuit ut I Know Someone olim moderaret curationem quaestionum mentis et psychologiae Mad Lady?

source: After his demise, did Mad Lady’s problems exacerbate?
target: Post eorum interitum, num problemata Mad Lady exacerbabantur?

source: Lumian quickly formulated a plausible explanation, but considering Mad Lady’s conduct on the betrothal ship, her current state struck him as abnormal.
target: Lumian celeriter rationem plausibilem elocutus est, sed de actu Mad Lady in nave nuptiali commemorata, status eius ei insolitus videbatur.

source: On the betrothal ship, faced with the impending release of the sea’s power in the energy passageway, Mad Lady, though eager and seeking excitement, had an escape route.
target: In nave nuptiali, cum imminentis emissionis potentia maris in via energiae adversaretur, Mad Lady, licet excitata et studens novitatem, viam effugii habebat.

source: As long as she didn’t delay until the last moment, she could teleport away, avoiding the actual risk of death.
target: Dum usque ad extremum tempus non moraretur, se teletranslata poterat, periculum mortalitatis verum evitans.

source: Now, whatever lurked in the depths of the tunnel made Lumian, despite his feigned high level, intuitively uneasy.
target: Nunc, quidquid in profundo tunelli latuit, Lumian, licet altum se praetendens, sensu intuitivo inquietum habebat.

source: He believed it represented an almost certain death sentence.
target: Credidit id fere sententiam mortis certissimam repraesentare.

source: Yet, Mad Lady persisted in her attempt to approach!
target: Tamen Mad Lady conatu accessus perseveravit!

source: Could there be a reason compelling her to make contact with that object?
target: Num ratione sit quae eam ad hoc obiectum contingendum impellat?

source: Lumian wondered.
target: Lumian miratus est.

source: He suspected that Mad Lady’s actions might be part of the Celestial Worthy’s scheme, convincing her that she could confront the provocation head‑on and escape in time.
target: Suspicabatur acta Mad Lady fortasse partem consilii Celestial Worthy constituere, quae eam persuasit se provocationi directe opponere atque tempore effugere posse.

source: I can’t let her and that Celestial Worthy succeed…
target: Non possum sinere eam atque illum Celestial Worthy succedere…

source: Besides, personally, I look forward to ending her myself rather than witnessing her being swallowed by that dangerous object…
target: Praeterea, personaliter, exspecto ut eam ipse finiam potius quam videam eam ab illo periculoso obiecto devorari…

source: Lumian’s eyes narrowed, the desire to teleport forward and intercept Mad Lady compelling him.
target: Oculi Lumiani contracti sunt, cupiditate se teletranslata et Mad Lady intercipienda impulsus.

source: However, preventing a Traveler from reaching a specific location in such a manner was clearly impossible.
target: Attamen, vitare Viatorem ad locum certum per hunc modum pervenire manifeste impossibile erat.

source: Lumian hesitated, unwilling to genuinely approach the flesh‑and‑blood “bird’s nest” deep within the tunnel.
target: Lumian dubitavit, vere appropinquare “nido” carne et sanguine constituto in profundo tunelli non volens.

source: Suddenly, an idea struck him.
target: Subito, idea eum percussit.

source: The peculiar structure’s rejection of outsiders seems to have lifted, and with Lato Guiaro, a person possessing a potent sea bloodline, deceased.
target: Reiectio exterorum a singulari structura videtur evanuisse, et Lato Guiaro, persona potentem sanguinem maris possidens, defunctus est.

source: Could I attempt to gain temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea to halt Mad Lady’s progress?
target: Possumne conari ut auctoritatem temporariam obtineam ut Praefectus Maris ad progressum Mad Lady coercendum?

source: With that in mind, Lumian embarked on his endeavor.
target: Hoc mente habens, Lumian in suum conatum profectus est.

source: Activating the power of the sea within him, he allowed his Astral Projection to merge and swiftly expand outward.
target: Potentiam maris in se excitans, permisit projectionem astralem suam coniungi et celeriter exterius expandi.
